name: CRUX
description: CRUX is a controlled retrieval-augmented context evaluation framework designed to assess the quality of retrieval-augmented contexts in long-form retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) tasks. It uses human-written summaries and question-based evaluation to measure how well the retrieved context covers essential information for generation.
reputation: A recent research benchmark with limited adoption so far, mainly used in the paper introducing it to evaluate retrieval context quality for long-form RAG.
notes: Framework uses human-written summaries to control information scope and provides fine-grained diagnostic evaluation of retrieval.
